contracts.semantics: Invocation snapshots every supplied debug appearance, verifies before minimum-signature deduplication, authorizes the exact installed operation, captures explicit source/time and emits receiver-signed outcome testimony.

Construct unsigned canonical table-ordered Claims under explicit author/time, with sorted repeatable fields. The seed writer remains a signing convenience; hosts may use their own author/sign capability. Never repair incoming signed descriptions.

Closed shape codecs and canonical bindings plus separate strict appearance verification. Pure shape readers alone do not authenticate; native parse accepts missing signature so size-before-verification priority can be enforced.

Authenticate receiver/configuration/request independently of optional request bytes; completed results with the actual request bind complete partitions and evaluation context. Refusal readback never authenticates invalid request claims. Strict opaque View decoding follows outer-body validation.

Explicit host capabilities provide key custody, finite receivedAt, durable journal operations and diagnostics. Boot snapshots signed configuration/declarations and exactly one seed convenience or author/sign selection. Returned outcome testimony must preserve exact requested claims and verify canonically; a signing failure after commit is a host fault, never known non-commit.

Native owner helper brackets one journal snapshot, all authorized signed rows and final head. It refuses change/damage/missing journal, never initializes a missing source, and exposes the native CAS facade only inside a witness.
Read one explicitly selected canonical signed SPEC3 definition act with exactly four roles, alg1 and explicit evaluation time. No latest-entity or global registry selection.

Validate top pins, kind-specific duplicate names, complete reachable named/pinned references, cycles, operator sorts, principal predicates and binding environments in deterministic category order; construct only the selected registry.

Decode exactly the existing canonical SPEC5 View algebra, including nested bytes leaves with nonempty MIME; reject duplicate maps, noncanonical encodings, bare byte strings, integer numeric spellings and invalid leaves.
Additional native verifier requires canonical lowercase author/signature debug spelling while preserving the legacy byte verifier API. It performs no key lookup or observations.

SPEC-16 lossless canonical full Schema appearances preserve optional name/alg separately from unchanged props/default schemaHash. Strict receiving decode, explicit semantic AST budgets and fixed error categories. Pure evidence codec, no execution/source permission claim.

SPEC-16 bounded pure lossless HView envelope helpers; full original appearance keys and reading metadata are distinct from DeltaID/schemaHash/existing HView identity. No command or authorization dependency.

Encode native HView occurrences with authored pointer slots, original signed or legal unsigned evidence, exact reachable sorted tables, explicit entry order/annotation/legacy reading absence and finite limits.

Strict receiving codec requires exact canonical wire and support closure, validates signatures without choosing another same-ID appearance, rejects malformed/cyclic/bounded evidence; returns native evidence, not execution proof.
Closed new-prefix signed role/argument codecs; opaque result payload only.
Exact boot binding plus metadata-only capture/authority testimony and separate full snapshot; host grant required.
Gather at explicit operand/definition/serving context from granted exact source; complete envelope result.
Delivery exactly request+evidence; embedded complete closure including top acts to existing View bytes, no source acquisition.
Compact public source commitments, one shared Basis; recomputed evidence hashes vs attested source commitments explicit. Structural/contextual readback is not execution proof.
Native key/config/grant/capability selection is explicit; descriptions cannot install themselves.

Pure supplied-input validation projection of stages1–4,6–8; all applicable input limits including supplied resolve envelope; no native source grant/currentness, execution or produced output guarantee.
Pure MR04 grammar-position semantic AST budget over distinct supplied definition bodies; references not inlined, no native grammar widening. Existing M1 reading traversal delegates here.
